scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contract/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/sim/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/sim/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/sim-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/sim-host/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test packages/sim/test/*.test.ts packages/db/test/*.test.ts apps/sim-host/test/*.test.ts apps/client/test/*.test.ts apps/desktop/test/*.test.ts
scripts.lint: eslint packages/contract packages/sim packages/db apps/sim-host apps/client apps/desktop eslint.config.js --max-warnings 0
scripts.desktop:start: npm run client:build && npm run desktop:build && npm run start -w @boing-pets/desktop
scripts.backup:now: fly machine run registry.fly.io/boing-living-pets-backup:latest -a boing-living-pets-backup --region iad --vm-memory 256 --restart no --rm
scripts.backup:check: fly machine run registry.fly.io/boing-living-pets-backup:latest /usr/local/bin/restore-check.sh -a boing-living-pets-backup --region iad --vm-memory 256 --restart no --rm
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run client:build && npm run client:check-bundle && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:smoke
